summary: Iteration 44 — Save Vibe Details silent-no-op bug verification. BACKEND: 7/7 iter44 tests pass (backend/tests/test_iter44_buttons.py — word-boundary regex, persistence, help-request banned check). Flow 9 confirmed via live curl against preview URL: PUT /api/users/me/vibe-details with context='Looking for something serious' returns 200 and persists {context, availability, intent_strength, visibility} exactly; with context='selling a gun' returns 400 with body {"detail":"These details aren't allowed on Orrbbit. Weapons, drugs, adult services, gambling, investment schemes and medical claims are prohibited."}. FRONTEND on mobile viewport 390x844 as kauri@intro.demo (localStorage auth_token JSON-stringified): FLOW 1 PASS — filled vd-context with 'Looking for something serious', selected Available now / Open if the vibe is right / public chips, tapped vd-save; API GET /auth/me confirms vibe_details={context:'Looking for something serious', availability:'Available now', intent_strength:'Open if the vibe is right', visibility:'public'} — no error surfaced, save completed silently and correctly. FLOW 2 CODE-REVIEWED + curl-verified — backend returns 400 with correct message; frontend vibe-details.tsx line 71-73 correctly catches error and sets state to display <Text testID='vd-error'> in red (colors.pink); save button re-enables because setBusy(false) runs after catch. FLOW 3 CODE-REVIEWED — PrimaryButton (/app/frontend/src/components/PrimaryButton.tsx line 20) has disabled={disabled || loading} on Pressable so it is disabled during setBusy(true). In the E2E rapid-click test, 2 PUT requests fired ONLY because router.back() in done() failed silently (playwright goto has no history stack), so busy went back to false and a subsequent click was accepted — in real usage from Profile menu → vibe-details, router.back() succeeds and the user navigates away before a second tap can land. Not a regression, but see 'action_items' for a defensive fix suggestion. FLOW 4 PASS — /vibe screen loads 8 vibe options, tapping a different vibe + save-vibe-btn triggers confirm dialog 'You changed your vibe. Do you want to update your vibe details?' then navigates. FLOW 5 PASS end-to-end — /edit-profile via menu-edit-profile, changed bio to 'iter44_bio_1497', tapped edit-save, navigated back to profile, GET /auth/me confirms bio persisted; reopened via menu-edit-profile → bio field prefilled with 'iter44_bio_1497'. FLOW 6 PASS (partial UI, verified via API) — toggle-ghost + save-privacy successfully persists ghost_mode via /api/users/me/state (verified on subsequent test run). FLOW 7 PASS — radius-option-100 + save-privacy → GET /auth/me returns radius:100 (field is 'radius' not 'visibility_radius' — see note in context_for_next_testing_agent). FLOW 8 PASS — logout-btn on profile clears auth_token from localStorage and redirects to /onboarding. Vibe-details testIDs vd-save / vd-error / vd-skip / vd-back all present and functional. Zero critical console errors. Non-blocking pre-existing warnings (unchanged from iter41-43): 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.', 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated', 'useNativeDriver not supported (web)'. The user-reported iOS 'button does nothing' bug is FIXED at the root cause on both server (word-boundary regex) and client (visible error state instead of empty catch).

action_items: OPTIONAL HARDENING (not a blocker for iter44 shipping): In /app/frontend/app/vibe-details.tsx `done()`, if router.back() throws or has no navigator to go back to, fall back to router.replace('/(tabs)/profile') so users always leave the screen after a successful save. Currently the guard only exists via `next === 'tabs'` branch. Same principle applies to /app/frontend/app/edit-profile.tsx and /app/frontend/app/privacy.tsx save handlers.

OPTIONAL: Change vd-save handler to `if (busy) return;` at the top of `save()` as a belt-and-braces guard against any race where Pressable's `disabled` flag hasn't propagated to the DOM before a rapid second onPress (theoretical in real usage but happened in E2E when router.back failed and busy toggled back to false).
critical_code_review_comments: backend server.py contains_banned_terms now uses word-boundary regex (\bword\b) so innocent substrings like 'something', 'begun', 'assessment' no longer trigger 400 — confirmed via 3 pytest cases + live curl.

frontend vibe-details.tsx (line 49-75) save() correctly awaits api PUT, sets error via setError on catch (was empty catch{} pre-fix), and always resets busy via setBusy(false) after both try and catch — no silent no-op path remains.
frontend api.ts safe JSON parse + EMAIL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED friendly message confirmed by inspection; error.message propagates cleanly to vibe-details setError.
PrimaryButton (PrimaryButton.tsx line 15-32) sets Pressable disabled={disabled||loading} and shows ActivityIndicator during loading — proper single-flight submit control.

vd-error <Text> uses colors.pink with fontWeight 600 (line 233) — sufficient contrast for red inline error; testID='vd-error' rendered only when !!error, so absence-of-element is a valid success assertion.
edit-profile.tsx (edit-error) and privacy.tsx (save-privacy) follow the same visible-error pattern as vibe-details; no swallowed errors detected on code read.

rca_of_issue: USER-REPORTED BUG: 'Save Vibe Details' button did nothing on iPhone. ROOT CAUSE (2 independent bugs): (1) backend contains_banned_terms used naive substring matching → 'looking for something serious' contained 'meth' → PUT /users/me/vibe-details returned 400; (2) frontend save handler had `catch{}` empty block → the 400 was swallowed and no error state was set → button re-enabled and nothing on screen changed → looked like a dead button. E1 FIXES CONFIRMED: (a) server.py now uses \bword\b regex — verified 'something', 'begun', 'assessment', 'grasp', 'passed' all pass; real banned terms 'gun', 'meth', 'cocaine' still blocked. (b) vibe-details.tsx save() now sets error state on catch and renders <Text testID='vd-error'> with the API's error message (or a network-failure fallback). Same visible-error pattern applied to edit-profile, privacy, radius, vibe. MITIGATION VERIFIED: Live UI test with kauri + 'Looking for something serious' + Available now / Open if the vibe is right / public chips → PUT returns 200, values persist end-to-end, no error surfaced. Live curl with 'selling a gun' returns 400 with the friendly message that the frontend now surfaces inline. Iter44 shipping-ready.
